name: pagination
useFor: Use under a long list or table. Show the first, last and the pages around the current one with ellipses between. Give links real hrefs or handle clicks; disable Previous on the first page and Next on the last with aria-disabled.
constraints: Pagination for fewer than two pages
source: Extrapolated from Agentcard (button.tsx keys, tabs.tsx blue key)
title: Pagination
description: Page keys in the display face: quiet until current, which is the blue key.
